## Why Choose Aqua-Barrier®?

### Quality Assured

Feel confident in our engineer stamped and certified product, crafted with exceptional quality and a
stabilizing internal baffle for superior performance and reliability.

### Quick & Easy to Use

Save on labor costs with our  patented(# 9,353,496) end pipe-loop system that is easy to maneuver
and installs 3-5 times faster than other solutions.

### Minimal Impact

The most environmentally-friendly solution on the market with little to no impact to terrain and
wildlife.

### Unrivaled Performance

The only cofferdam you can re-use 15-20 times. We stand by our product and warranty the first
install.

## Custom Solutions for Every Need

Aqua-Barrier® offers personalized solutions, with rentals and purchases to accommodate any project
length. Contact us to start the process of finding the right Aqua-Barrier size and type for your
project.
* Control invasive water in floodwater situations
* Provide access to underwater areas for construction
* Sediment retention in environmentally sensitive areas
* Divert water flow in dynamic water environment

## Radiation Protection Products

Barrier Technologies® is America’s leading manufacturer of **radiation protection products**. We are
committed to continual innovation and serving the medical industry by producing superior **radiation
shielding products** using high quality of **radiation shielding **materials.

## Our Radiation Protection Products

We control the quality of our products by manufacturing everything in-house. From metal fabrication
to fabric manufacturing and product assembly, all our **x ray** radiation products are created
within our facilities.

Our industry-leading products include lightweight lead-free aprons, [velcro-free thyroid
collars][29], protective gloves, leaded eye protection, [mobile lead shields][30], and many more
radiation safety products.

## Innovation in Radiation Protection Technology

Barrier Technologies’ tenacious drive to innovate is one of the qualities that sets us apart from
other radiation shield manufacturers. From leadership to engineering, every tier of our company is
motivated to develop new solutions to problems within our sphere of the medical industry.

### Ultraflex™ and MagnaGuard™ Technology Products

Two powerful examples of our commitment to innovation are our Ultraflex™ and MagnaGuard™ proprietary
products:
* **Ultraflex™** is an outer material for our aprons, vests, and mobile shields. Unlike traditional
  nylon, which is porous and can’t be washed, we engineered Ultraflex™ to be an antibacterial and
  stain-free fabric — helping medical personnel maintain a sterile environment.
* **MagnaGuard™** is a patented magnetic closure we developed to eliminate the use of velcro on
  aprons and thyroid guards. Studies have shown velcro to be a transmitter of dangerous bacteria and
  disease. MagnaGuard™ mitigates these risks.

Our innovative products are also inspired by our customers. For example, our breakthrough Terminator
XR™ mobile lead shields were developed after a local doctor asked us to create an alternative to
cumbersome hanging lead shields.

If you are dissatisfied with your current **radiation protection products**, contact our team and
inquire about our customization services.

## Radiation Protection Products Made in USA

From lead shields to protective eyewear, Barrier Technologies is your one-stop-shop for all things
**radiation shielding**. Our catalog includes everything necessary to build a robust, easy-to-clean
radiation protection suit:

### [Protective Aprons][31]

We offer an expansive variety of lead and lead-free aprons that can be customized to meet the unique
needs of your medical organization. Don’t have time to wait for a custom order? Then order from our
Ready To Go line of aprons — a selection of Ultraflex™ and MagnaGuard™ equipped aprons that ship
within 24 hours of your order.

### [Radiation Protection Gloves][32]

Our lead-free and powder-free Secure Touch® gloves empower your physicians with the highest level of
**radiation shielding** in the industry. Textured fingers and palms improve grip and we’ve designed
the gloves with curved fingers and a hypoallergenic internal coating to maximize comfort.

### [Radiation Protective Eyewear][33]

Our vast catalog of leaded glasses provide the highest lead content in the industry and can be
delivered in your exact prescription. In contrast to foreign-made eyewear, our lenses don’t yellow
over time and can be coated with an anti-reflective and anti-fog coating for maximum clarity.

## Globally Trusted Flood Defence Since 1994

FCI designs, supplies and installs more flood protection solutions than anyone else on the planet —
across thousands of projects, on every continent.

## Built for Every Flood Threat

River flooding, coastal flood risk, flash floods, storm surges or sewer overflow. Whatever the risk,
our engineers design custom [flood barriers][86], [flood gates][87], [flood doors][88] and [chemical
spill containment][89] flood prevention systems built to perform when it matters most.

## Trusted by the World's Most Critical Infrastructure

Flooding is devastating. The right flood defence partner makes all the difference. FCI protects
nuclear power stations, utility sites, commercial developments, business parks, factories, hotels,
shopping centres and residential developments — from New York to London to Brisbane.

## A Truly Global Operation

Headquartered in the UK, with a major US subsidiary and distributors worldwide, FCI delivers
dependable flood protection and prevention solutions wherever you need them.

**Innovation. Dependability. Integrity.**

operated so that the flood barrier can be operated in advance of floods with full peace of mind.
They can also be manually operated as required.

From simple stackable stop log flood barriers to fully automatic floodgates that operate only when
required, Flood Control International design flood barriers with flood protection heights up to 30ft
and unlimited length.

Automatic flood barriers can operate to self-raise with the rising flood water or be push button
operated so that the flood barrier can be operated in advance of floods with full peace of mind.
They can also be manually operated as required.

## FLOOD GATES

FCI’s specialist engineers design tailor-made flood gates that provide dependable flood protection
whilst maximizing access availability. The floodgates can be designed to operate on a level
threshold allowing unrestricted vehicle, pedestrian and disabled access.

Lightweight aluminum flood gates are available in widths up to 15ft and flood defense heights up to
6ft, and our steel floodgates are designed to any size. All flood gates can be automatic and
push-button operated if required.

We make hinged flood gates, pivot flood gates and rolling flood gates in a full range of sizes.

door is shut, it is flood proof. Our unique gasket arrangement guarantees flood protection to full
height or above and flood doors can be fitted with a range of access / egress and security features
as required.

against chemical spillage or firefighting run-off.

# FLOOD PROTECTION SOLUTIONS by
# Flood Control INTERNATIONAL

## Globally Trusted Flood Defence Since 1994

FCI designs, supplies and installs more flood protection solutions than anyone else on the planet —
across thousands of projects, on every continent.

## Built for Every Flood Threat

River flooding, coastal flood risk, flash floods, storm surges or sewer overflow. Whatever the risk,
our engineers design custom [flood barriers][86], [flood gates][87], [flood doors][88] and [chemical
spill containment][89] flood prevention systems built to perform when it matters most.

## Trusted by the World's Most Critical Infrastructure

Flooding is devastating. The right flood defence partner makes all the difference. FCI protects
nuclear power stations, utility sites, commercial developments, business parks, factories, hotels,
shopping centres and residential developments — from New York to London to Brisbane.

## A Truly Global Operation

Headquartered in the UK, with a major US subsidiary and distributors worldwide, FCI delivers
dependable flood protection and prevention solutions wherever you need them.

# Is your inflatable dam
# reaching the end of its life?

[ Our Approach ][8]

#### Aging Inflatable Dams Increase Operational Risk

Many inflatable dam systems are reaching the end of their service life. Loss of OEM support
(including Bridgestone installations), material fatigue, UV degradation, and limited spare parts can
quickly turn aging infrastructure into operational risk.

We help dam owners evaluate, modernize, and replace aging inflatable dam systems to restore
reliability, maintain compliance, and ensure long-term operational continuity.

[ Contact us ][9]
[Emoticon-Entier-transparent]

#### We understand the whole system, Not just the rubber

Replacing an aging inflatable dam requires precise evaluation, engineered adaptation to existing
structures, and carefully managed implementation. Our approach is structured to reduce uncertainty
at every stage.

[Comprehensive technical evaluation of the existing membrane, anchoring systems, civil interface,
and control components. Objective: determine structural condition, remaining service life, and
viable intervention options.]

### DIAGNOSTIC & ANALYSIS

Comprehensive technical evaluation of the existing membrane, anchoring systems, civil interface, and
control components. Objective: determine structural condition, remaining service life, and viable
intervention options.
[Project-specific membrane and anchoring design adapted to existing foundations and hydraulic
constraints. Focus on compatibility, performance optimization, and long-term durability.]

### CUSTOM ENGINEERING

Project-specific membrane and anchoring design adapted to existing foundations and hydraulic
constraints. Focus on compatibility, performance optimization, and long-term durability.
[Structured implementation planning aligned with operational and seasonal constraints. Phased
execution strategies designed to minimize downtime and maintain water management stability.]

### EFFICIENT INSTALLATION

Structured implementation planning aligned with operational and seasonal constraints. Phased
execution strategies designed to minimize downtime and maintain water management stability.
[Post-installation guidance, technical validation, and lifecycle support to ensure sustained
performance and predictable maintenance.]

### ONGOING SUPPORT & MONITORING

Post-installation guidance, technical validation, and lifecycle support to ensure sustained
performance and predictable maintenance.
[ Request a Technical Assessment ][10]

#### REPAIR OR REPLACE?

#### Making the right long-term decision
1. Escalating maintenance costs
   * Small recurring interventions often mask increasing structural degradation.
2. OEM support limitations
   * When original manufacturers discontinue support, spare parts and technical validation become
     uncertain.
3. Material aging
   * UV exposure, cyclic inflation stress, temperature variation — these do not reverse.
4. Lifecycle economics
   * Compare: Continued patching VS Planned, engineered replacement

Rubber Dam Solutions, Flexible by nature. / Mecan-Hydro.

## About us

##### Bullflex Rubbers are Manufacturers and Exporters of Various Rubber Conveyor Belts and Special
##### Purpose Belts based in Vadodara, Gujarat, India. A Legacy spanning over 19 years.

## Reliable Manufacturers with satisfaction.

**Bullflex Rubbers Private Limited, formerly known as Vrushah Beltings Private Limited** – a dynamic
and visionary company rooted in Vadodara, Gujarat, India. With an impressive legacy spanning over 19
years, we stand as manufacturers and exporters of Rubber Conveyor Belts and Special-Purpose Conveyor
Beltings, driven by an unwavering commitment to delivering unparalleled quality products to clients
across the globe.

ABOUT DR. CALIN POP

Dr. Calin Pop obtained his degree in dentistry at “University of Medicine Iuliu Hatieganu”,
Cluj-Napoca, Romania. Following that, he opened his dental center in Romania for 11 years before
relocating to the UAE in 2017.

With more than 19 years of experience in complex restorative procedures, he is an avid promoter of
the concept of responsible dentistry, where everything is performed under rubber dam isolation, and
an appropriate amount of time is devoted to each step in the process, for a perfect and reliable
result.

World-renowned educator, author of the “Rubber Dam Master Online Course” – an online best seller
course about the integration of rubber dam isolation in daily practice. The Course is translated in
5 languages (English, Spanish, Russian, Romanian, Turkish) and is rated 9.4/10 on Coursemarks (the
trustpilot of online courses).

Published in “Journal Of Cosmetic Dentistry” – the official publication of the AACD (American
Academy of Cosmetic Dentistry).

[laterals first page.001]

ABOUT DR. CALIN POP

Dr. Calin Pop is a restorative dentist, entrepreneur, and internationally recognized educator with
over 20 years of clinical experience. A graduate of the University of Medicine and Pharmacy “Iuliu
Hațieganu” in Cluj-Napoca, Romania, he led his own dental center for 11 years before relocating to
the United Arab Emirates in 2017, where he continues to practice with a focus on advanced
restorative dentistry.

He is the creator of Fixlite, an innovative dental photography system designed to standardize and
simplify clinical documentation, now used by dentists worldwide.

Dr. Pop is a leading advocate of responsible dentistry, promoting meticulous, step-by-step treatment
protocols performed under strict rubber dam isolation to achieve predictable, long-lasting results.

He is the author of the bestselling “Rubber Dam Master” Online Course, translated into five
languages. His work has been featured in the Journal of Cosmetic Dentistry, the official publication
of the American Academy of Cosmetic Dentistry (AACD)

ABOUT DR. CALIN POP

Dr. Calin Pop obtained his degree in dentistry at “University of Medicine Iuliu Hatieganu”,
Cluj-Napoca, Romania. Following that, he opened his dental center in Romania for 11 years before
relocating to the UAE in 2017.

With more than 19 years of experience in complex restorative procedures, he is an avid promoter of
the concept of responsible dentistry, where everything is performed under rubber dam isolation, and
an appropriate amount of time is devoted to each step in the process, for a perfect and reliable
result.

World-renowned educator, author of the “Rubber Dam Master Online Course” – an online best seller
course about the integration of rubber dam isolation in daily practice. The Course is translated in
5 languages (English, Spanish, Russian, Romanian, Turkish) and is rated 9.4/10 on Coursemarks (the
trustpilot of online courses).

Published in “Journal Of Cosmetic Dentistry” – the official publication of the AACD (American
Academy of Cosmetic Dentistry).

[laterals first page.001]

ABOUT DR. CALIN POP

Dr. Calin Pop is a restorative dentist, entrepreneur, and internationally recognized educator with
over 20 years of clinical experience. A graduate of the University of Medicine and Pharmacy “Iuliu
Hațieganu” in Cluj-Napoca, Romania, he led his own dental center for 11 years before relocating to
the United Arab Emirates in 2017, where he continues to practice with a focus on advanced
restorative dentistry.

He is the creator of Fixlite, an innovative dental photography system designed to standardize and
simplify clinical documentation, now used by dentists worldwide.

Dr. Pop is a leading advocate of responsible dentistry, promoting meticulous, step-by-step treatment
protocols performed under strict rubber dam isolation to achieve predictable, long-lasting results.

He is the author of the bestselling “Rubber Dam Master” Online Course, translated into five
languages. His work has been featured in the Journal of Cosmetic Dentistry, the official publication
of the American Academy of Cosmetic Dentistry (AACD)

# Specialist in custom design of Inflatable Rubber Dams and Spillway Gates

Dyrhoff has been successfully completing projects across various countries in Europe, the Americas,
Asia, and Africa since 2005, showcasing our global reach.
[ Learn More ][24]
[ Contact Us ][25]
[Payette River Basin, Emmett Dam for Irrigation]

## About Dyrhoff

Dyrhoff specialises in inflatable rubber dams and spillway gates, with a history dating back to 1989
in Europe. In 2003, we acquired Sumigate from Sumitomo Electric, a global leader in rubber dams.
Dyrhoff's rubber dams follow Japanese Technical Standards. They are also the main European agent for
Obermeyer Hydro spillway gates, offering complete systems and steel component manufacturing. Dyrhoff
provides flexible services, including full-turnkey solutions and impartial advice on gate systems
for various applications.

## Our Products

### Inflatable Dams

The rubber dam is a permanent structure comprising a sheet of rubber-coated fabric which is fixed to
a reinforced concrete foundation using clamp plates and anchor bolts. The rubber dam is inflated by
pumping air or water inside the rubber body until the design height or pressure is reached. It is
deflated by allowing the air or water inside the rubber body to escape.
[ Read More ][36]

### Spillway Gates

Spillway gates are a row of steel gate panels supported on their downstream side by inflatable air
bladders. By controlling the pressure in the bladders, the pond elevation maintained by the gates
can be infinitely adjusted within the system control range (full inflation to full deflation) and
accurately maintained at user-selected set-points.
[ Read More ][37]

## Why use Dyrhoff?

Dyrhoff excels in water control structures, boasting over 30+ years of specialized expertise in
designing inflatable rubber dams and spillway gates. With a global presence, reputable partnerships,
on-site supervision, and a commitment to continuous improvement through active research and
development, Dyrhoff offers unparalleled solutions.

# Specialist in custom design of Inflatable Rubber Dams and Spillway Gates

Dyrhoff has been successfully completing projects across various countries in Europe, the Americas,
Asia, and Africa since 2005, showcasing our global reach.
[ Learn More ][24]
[ Contact Us ][25]
[Payette River Basin, Emmett Dam for Irrigation]

## About Dyrhoff

Dyrhoff specialises in inflatable rubber dams and spillway gates, with a history dating back to 1989
in Europe. In 2003, we acquired Sumigate from Sumitomo Electric, a global leader in rubber dams.
Dyrhoff's rubber dams follow Japanese Technical Standards. They are also the main European agent for
Obermeyer Hydro spillway gates, offering complete systems and steel component manufacturing. Dyrhoff
provides flexible services, including full-turnkey solutions and impartial advice on gate systems
for various applications.

## Our Products

### Inflatable Dams

The rubber dam is a permanent structure comprising a sheet of rubber-coated fabric which is fixed to
a reinforced concrete foundation using clamp plates and anchor bolts. The rubber dam is inflated by
pumping air or water inside the rubber body until the design height or pressure is reached. It is
deflated by allowing the air or water inside the rubber body to escape.
[ Read More ][36]

### Spillway Gates

Spillway gates are a row of steel gate panels supported on their downstream side by inflatable air
bladders. By controlling the pressure in the bladders, the pond elevation maintained by the gates
can be infinitely adjusted within the system control range (full inflation to full deflation) and
accurately maintained at user-selected set-points.
[ Read More ][37]

## Why use Dyrhoff?

Dyrhoff excels in water control structures, boasting over 30+ years of specialized expertise in
designing inflatable rubber dams and spillway gates. With a global presence, reputable partnerships,
on-site supervision, and a commitment to continuous improvement through active research and
development, Dyrhoff offers unparalleled solutions.

# The FREE science and technology book

[CCD chip from a webcam.]

Want to know why giant ships can float, how your earbuds make music, what graphene is, or how
windows can clean themselves? You've come to the right place! Here you'll find simple explanations
you can really understand—hurrah!

## Hard stuff... made simple!

[Model of a steam turbine at Think Tank science museum, Birmingham, England.]

Explain that Stuff is an online book written by science writer [Chris Woodford][9] (author of many
popular science books for adults and children). It includes over 400 easy-to-understand articles,
richly illustrated with over 4000 photos, artworks, and animations, covering how things work,
cutting-edge science, cool gadgets, and computers. We take the "pain" from explain and the "tough"
out of stuff! There's more information on this website than in your average expensive science book,
it's 100% human written (absolutely no "AI slop"), it's continually updated, and it's completely
free to use! Explain that Stuff also helps to support [curriculum learning][10] (conventional STEM
education and home-schooling).

## How to use this site

There are five simple ways to find what you want:
1. [A-Z index][11]: Browse articles by name.
2. [Timeline][12]: Find inventions by date.
3. [Random][13]: Discover something new.
4. [Search][14]: Use the search engine (at the top of each page).
5. [Teaching guide][15]: Browse study topics.

## What's new?

Some of our newest and most recently updated articles...

[Chromatography makes ink smudge on wet paper.]

### [Chromatography][16]

One of the most important techniques for separating and analyzing chemicals... is 120 years old!

[Dark red sunrise over Dorset, England.]

### [Solar cells][17]

How did solar become the world's favourite new form of power... and what does the future hold for
it?

[How a hybrid car works.]

### [Electric cars][18]

Are they as good as the hype? Are they as clean and green as people claim? Why are they taking so
long to catch on?

[Concept of artificial intelligence: an AI dummy superimposed on a green circuit board.]

### [Artificial intelligence][19]

Can we imagine a world where computers are smart enough not to need us? Is "human intelligence" a
good starting point for designing useful machines?

[The force of gravity is slightly greater at the equator than at the poles airplane.]

### [Gravity][20]

It's taken over two millenia for people to understand how gravity holds the universe together. What
do we know so far about this most mysterious of forces?

[Orange Schlieren photograph of two supersonic jets flying upward]

### [History of flight][21]

Planes can trace their history back thousands of years to ancient myths and legends. Why have humans
always dreamed of soaring to the sky... and why did it take us so long?

[Giant pulley wheels in a large crane]

### [Cranes][22]

The science behind cranes is easy to understand, but why are there so many different types? How much
can they lift... and what stops them toppling over?

[Aristotle pictured at the National Academy of Sciences, Washington, D.C.]

### [History of electricity][23]

Electricity is an ancient science that powers our modern world. Why did it take so long to figure
out how it works and put it to practical use? Find out in our sparky story of electric power!

[Black laptop computer loading software from an open red DVD]

### [Software][24]

Computers are wonderful machines you can reprogram to do almost anything. Learn more about
algorithms, computer languages, and the basic principles of coding in our simple guide.

[Silverback gorilla eating bamboo.]

### [Great psychology experiments][25]

It's no big surprise that other people aren't quite what they seem. But the astonishing finding from
modern psychology is that even our own minds are strange and complex things we don't fully
understand.

[Experiment exposing organisms to blue excitation lighting]

### [What is science—and why does it matter?][26]

From atoms and cells to nuclear power plants and the human brain, the scope of science is truly
amazing. But what exactly is the scientific method... and why is it still our best hope for making
sense of the world?

[Gray plastic Hitachi transistor radio]

### [History of communication][27]

How did we get from the alphabet to the Internet in a few thousand years? Follow the story of shared
information from cuneiform and hieroglyphs, through radio and TV, to streaming media and the Web.

## Hidromont delivers advanced water control solutions, specialising in SR Gates and Rubber Dams.

### Hidromont has been actively involved in the Rubber Dam and SR Gate industry since 2018,
### delivering advanced water control solutions across Europe and Asia.

We specialize in the design, manufacture, supply, and installation of [Rubber Dams][5] and
[Steel/Rubber Gates][6], providing comprehensive support throughout every phase of a project. Our
comprehensive offerings include high-quality products that are engineered to meet the most stringent
standards of performance and durability.

Our approach is hands-on and collaborative, ensuring that we are involved at every stage—from
initial design and engineering to the manufacturing process and on-site installation. We work
closely with our clients to ensure that each system is customized to meet specific site requirements
and operational goals.

Each component of our SR Gates and Rubber Dams is carefully designed and manufactured by trusted,
reputable suppliers, ensuring reliability and efficiency in every system we provide. We take pride
in our ability to offer complete, turnkey SR Gate systems and Rubber Dam solutions, delivering
everything from initial design to full system integration.

Beyond just supplying high-end products, Hidromont is committed to ensuring seamless installation
and operation. We offer dedicated on-site supervision throughout the entire installation process,
working closely with contractors to guide them through every stage—from the installation and testing
of the Steel/Rubber Gates or Rubber Dams to their final commissioning.

Our experienced team is on hand to ensure that each project is executed smoothly, safely, and in
accordance with the highest industry standards.

With Hidromont, you can trust that your water control systems are in expert hands, from start to
finish.

#### [Rubber Dams][7]

• **Adjustable**: Easily raised or lowered to manage fluctuating water levels.
• **Fast Installation**: Quick to deploy, reducing setup time and costs.
• **Low Maintenance**: Minimal upkeep required, saving on long-term costs.
• **Cost-Effective**: Ideal for sites where traditional structures are impractical or expensive.
• **Durable**: UV and environment-resistant for long-lasting performance.
• **Versatile**: Suitable for flood control, irrigation, hydroelectric generation, and more.

#### [SR Gates][8]

• **Precise Control**: Accurate regulation of water flow for flood management and reservoir control.
• **Durable**: Corrosion-resistant materials ensure long-term reliability.
• **Low Maintenance**: Fewer moving parts, simplifying upkeep.
• **Flexible**: Can be automated for remote operation and integrated into existing infrastructure.
• **Reliable Performance**: Designed to handle varying water pressures, ensuring consistent
operation even in extreme conditions.

## Hidromont delivers advanced water control solutions, specialising in SR Gates and Rubber Dams.

### Hidromont has been actively involved in the Rubber Dam and SR Gate industry since 2018,
### delivering advanced water control solutions across Europe and Asia.

We specialize in the design, manufacture, supply, and installation of [Rubber Dams][5] and
[Steel/Rubber Gates][6], providing comprehensive support throughout every phase of a project. Our
comprehensive offerings include high-quality products that are engineered to meet the most stringent
standards of performance and durability.

Our approach is hands-on and collaborative, ensuring that we are involved at every stage—from
initial design and engineering to the manufacturing process and on-site installation. We work
closely with our clients to ensure that each system is customized to meet specific site requirements
and operational goals.

Each component of our SR Gates and Rubber Dams is carefully designed and manufactured by trusted,
reputable suppliers, ensuring reliability and efficiency in every system we provide. We take pride
in our ability to offer complete, turnkey SR Gate systems and Rubber Dam solutions, delivering
everything from initial design to full system integration.

Beyond just supplying high-end products, Hidromont is committed to ensuring seamless installation
and operation. We offer dedicated on-site supervision throughout the entire installation process,
working closely with contractors to guide them through every stage—from the installation and testing
of the Steel/Rubber Gates or Rubber Dams to their final commissioning.

Our experienced team is on hand to ensure that each project is executed smoothly, safely, and in
accordance with the highest industry standards.

With Hidromont, you can trust that your water control systems are in expert hands, from start to
finish.

#### [Rubber Dams][7]

• **Adjustable**: Easily raised or lowered to manage fluctuating water levels.
• **Fast Installation**: Quick to deploy, reducing setup time and costs.
• **Low Maintenance**: Minimal upkeep required, saving on long-term costs.
• **Cost-Effective**: Ideal for sites where traditional structures are impractical or expensive.
• **Durable**: UV and environment-resistant for long-lasting performance.
• **Versatile**: Suitable for flood control, irrigation, hydroelectric generation, and more.

#### [SR Gates][8]

• **Precise Control**: Accurate regulation of water flow for flood management and reservoir control.
• **Durable**: Corrosion-resistant materials ensure long-term reliability.
• **Low Maintenance**: Fewer moving parts, simplifying upkeep.
• **Flexible**: Can be automated for remote operation and integrated into existing infrastructure.
• **Reliable Performance**: Designed to handle varying water pressures, ensuring consistent
operation even in extreme conditions.

# Welcome to HTE Engineering

## Global Leader in Inflatable Rubber Dam Solutions

[ Request a consultation > ][116]
[ Discover our services > ][117]

## our Mission

## our Mission

HTE Engineering LLC is the world’s premier supplier of inflatable rubber dam systems, trusted by
governments, engineers, and infrastructure partners across the globe. With decades of experience
designing and implementing our systems in some of the most challenging environments, HTE has earned
a reputation as the go-to expert for dam, weir, and water control projects worldwide.

Our team provides end-to-end, innovative solutions tailored to meet complex water management needs.
At the core of our offering is the complete inflatable crest gate system—a fully integrated solution
that includes:

 
* High-performance inflatable rubber bladder membranes
* Precision-engineered anchoring and clamping equipment for secure fastening to concrete foundations
* A fully automated control system with advanced instrumentation, including blowers, pumps, valves,
  sensors, and programmable control panels with remote monitoring capabilities

 

Every component is engineered for reliability, efficiency, and long-term performance. Whether your
project requires flood control, irrigation regulation, hydropower optimization, or environmental
water management, HTE delivers robust solutions that help clients achieve their operational goals
with confidence.

## What Are Rubber Dams and How Do They Work?

A **rubber dam** is a flexible, inflatable bladder anchored across a waterway, designed for dynamic
water level management. When water needs to be held back—for irrigation or power generation—the
bladder is inflated with air or water, creating a barrier. This raises the upstream water level,
effectively forming a reservoir.

Conversely, for flood control or to allow unobstructed flow, the bladder is rapidly deflated. It
flattens against the riverbed, allowing water to pass freely over it. This flexibility and quick

# Welcome to HTE Engineering

## Global Leader in Inflatable Rubber Dam Solutions

[ Request a consultation > ][116]
[ Discover our services > ][117]

## our Mission

## our Mission

HTE Engineering LLC is the world’s premier supplier of inflatable rubber dam systems, trusted by
governments, engineers, and infrastructure partners across the globe. With decades of experience
designing and implementing our systems in some of the most challenging environments, HTE has earned
a reputation as the go-to expert for dam, weir, and water control projects worldwide.

Our team provides end-to-end, innovative solutions tailored to meet complex water management needs.
At the core of our offering is the complete inflatable crest gate system—a fully integrated solution
that includes:

 
* High-performance inflatable rubber bladder membranes
* Precision-engineered anchoring and clamping equipment for secure fastening to concrete foundations
* A fully automated control system with advanced instrumentation, including blowers, pumps, valves,
  sensors, and programmable control panels with remote monitoring capabilities

 

Every component is engineered for reliability, efficiency, and long-term performance. Whether your
project requires flood control, irrigation regulation, hydropower optimization, or environmental
water management, HTE delivers robust solutions that help clients achieve their operational goals
with confidence.

## What Are Rubber Dams and How Do They Work?

A **rubber dam** is a flexible, inflatable bladder anchored across a waterway, designed for dynamic
water level management. When water needs to be held back—for irrigation or power generation—the
bladder is inflated with air or water, creating a barrier. This raises the upstream water level,
effectively forming a reservoir.

Conversely, for flood control or to allow unobstructed flow, the bladder is rapidly deflated. It
flattens against the riverbed, allowing water to pass freely over it. This flexibility and quick
operation make rubber dams a cost-effective and adaptable alternative to rigid gates, suitable for
various water management applications.

### Why Choose HTE Engineering for Rubber Dams?

HTE Engineering is a global leader in rubber dam services, with over 1,500 installations worldwide
since the 1990s. We provide end-to-end solutions, including manufacturing, material testing, custom
design, construction, installation, and ongoing maintenance. Our services also cover replacement
equipment for dams reaching the end of their service life. From New York to California, and across
the globe, our rubber dams reach heights of 18 feet and span sectioned widths over 3,500 feet,
thriving in varied climates and elevations. Our team’s rapid mobilization ensures we meet project
demands anywhere, anytime.

### What Are the Core Competencies of HTE’s Rubber Dam Services?

Operators often wonder what sets HTE apart. Our core competencies include offering free cost
estimates, customized designs tailored to site-specific needs, and rigorous strength and durability
testing of rubber materials. We provide UL-certified control Systems for safe, reliable operation,
along with expert installation supervision and comprehensive maintenance and replacement services.
This holistic approach ensures projects stay on budget and schedule, from concept to commissioning,
with exceptional after-sales support to keep systems running smoothly.

## Ready to transform your water resources plan?

### Broad Scope

### Indexed

### Peer-Reviewed

In the area of research and innovation, each day we passionately push the limits of science and

**more than 2 million articles ****downloads** per year.

IJER 100% emphasis on high quality research content, thorough peer-review which exists on all our
research and review articles , ensuring we publish scientifically sound research across a broad
spectrum of engineering areas.

Manuscripts submitted to The International Journal of Engineering Research & Technology should:
* contribute to existing research work;
* be original, and not have been published anywhere;
* present data clearly and concisely;
* mention engineering data & applications;

All accepted papers in IJERT will be published under a Creative Commons Licence and will be freely
available on the IJERT Digital Library.

IJERT has the team of **more than **[2000 prominent reviewers][44]** and renowned [editorial board
members][45]** from well-known academic institutions around the globe. The primary goal of the
reviewers & editors is to maintain high quality of publications. The articles that are sent for
reviews are handled by state of art online manuscript review system, with a view towards making fast
& fair review process. The Editors reserve the right to reject papers without sending them out for
review.

The IJERT is not limited to a specific areas of science and engineering but is instead covers wide
range of branches of engineering and sciences. The major subject areas covered by the journal are
following:
* Computer Science & Engineering
* Architecture and Planning
* Applied Sciences
* Applied Engineering
* Electronics & Communication Engineering
* Chemical Engineering
* Civil Engineering
* Textile Engineering
* Environmental Engineering
* Electrical Engineering
* Industrial Engineering
* Mechanical Engineering [**and more**][46]

The IJERT’s GOLD OPEN ACCESS model is supported through very nominal Article Processing Charges.
There is **no any fee associated with submission to this journal.** We also offer discounts to
students and **100% fee waivers for researchers** in developing countries, determined using the
criteria* set by [WorldBank.][47]

Almost all university and colleges research in both science and engineering is performed as a
component of the advanced education of students. For most engineering & science students, the goal
of a career in industry motivates their pursuit of advanced study, and this will increasingly be the
case in the future and IJERT helps them to achieve their goal.

[IJERT Journal Cover]

**International Journal of Engineering Research & Technology** is a **peer-reviewed, open access**
and **multidisciplinary engineering, technology and science journal** that publishes original
research & review articles of all major branches of Engineering, Science and Technology. We have
adopted a fully open access publishing model which allows open global access to its published
content so anyone can download & read articles round the clock totally free of cost. IJERT is
included in many leading abstracting and indexing open access databases like Google Scholar &
ResearchGate. For a complete list, [view here.][42]

IJERT does not charge readers or their institutions for access to more than 25000 published
articles. The open access supports the rights of users to read, download, copy, distribute, print,
search, or link to the full texts of these articles provided they are properly acknowledged and
cited.

IJERT publishes **12 issues per year** not including special conference issues.

[
][43]

### Why Publish in IJERT ?

### Broad Scope

Impact of your work will have on researchers outside your field and the potential for greater
exposure.

### Indexed

Increase visibility, availability, and readership of your work on internet which attracts good
citations.

### Peer-Reviewed

All articles are evaluated using criteria including the excellence, novelty and significance of the
research or ideas.

In the area of research and innovation, each day we passionately push the limits of science and
engineering by regularly publishing state-of-art peer reviewed research content in **IJERT having**
**more than 2 million articles ****downloads** per year.

IJER 100% emphasis on high quality research content, thorough peer-review which exists on all our
research and review articles , ensuring we publish scientifically sound research across a broad
spectrum of engineering areas.

Manuscripts submitted to The International Journal of Engineering Research & Technology should:
* contribute to existing research work;
* be original, and not have been published anywhere;
* present data clearly and concisely;
* mention engineering data & applications;

All accepted papers in IJERT will be published under a Creative Commons Licence and will be freely
available on the IJERT Digital Library.

IJERT has the team of **more than **[2000 prominent reviewers][44]** and renowned [editorial board
members][45]** from well-known academic institutions around the globe. The primary goal of the
reviewers & editors is to maintain high quality of publications. The articles that are sent for
reviews are handled by state of art online manuscript review system, with a view towards making fast
& fair review process. The Editors reserve the right to reject papers without sending them out for
review.

The IJERT is not limited to a specific areas of science and engineering but is instead covers wide
range of branches of engineering and sciences. The major subject areas covered by the journal are
following:
* Computer Science & Engineering
* Architecture and Planning
* Applied Sciences
* Applied Engineering
* Electronics & Communication Engineering
* Chemical Engineering
* Civil Engineering
* Textile Engineering
* Environmental Engineering
* Electrical Engineering
* Industrial Engineering
* Mechanical Engineering [**and more**][46]

The IJERT’s GOLD OPEN ACCESS model is supported through very nominal Article Processing Charges.
There is **no any fee associated with submission to this journal.** We also offer discounts to
students and **100% fee waivers for researchers** in developing countries, determined using the
criteria* set by [WorldBank.][47]

Almost all university and colleges research in both science and engineering is performed as a
component of the advanced education of students. For most engineering & science students, the goal
of a career in industry motivates their pursuit of advanced study, and this will increasingly be the
case in the future and IJERT helps them to achieve their goal.

* [
  2026-07-17
  
  ### AGING CHARACTERISTICS OF INFLATABLE RUBBER DAMS UPON EXPIRATION OF THEIR SERVICE LIFE
  
  According to the "GB/T50979 Technical Specification for Rubber Dam Engineering," the design
  service life of rubber dam bags is generally 15 to 20 years. When the dam bags reach their design
  service life, systemic problems such as material aging, performance degradation, functional
  failure, and deterioration of supporting equipment will occur. Conventional local repairs cannot
  fundamentally solve these problems, indicating that the entire dam bag is due for scrapping and
  requires complete replacement.
  ][28]
* [
  2026-07-15
  
  ### INFLATABLE RUBBER DAM MAINTENANCE PROCESS
  
  Inflatable Rubber Dam Maintenance Process Guide: From safety preparation to trial operation and
  acceptance, this guide covers dam bag wear repair, anchoring maintenance, and filling/draining
  system maintenance to ensure project compliance and safety. Key points: Minor wear requires
  meticulous repair; severe damage requires double-sided patching; major repairs require complete
  replacement of the entire dam. Each step involves strict temperature and pressure control,
  culminating in graded pressure tests and a 24-hour pressure holding test.
  ][29]
* [
  2026-07-13
  
  ### HOW TO SOLVE THE PROBLEM OF SHOULDER COLLAPSE IN INFLATABLE RUBBER DAMS?
  
  The shoulder collapse stems from insufficient dam end restraint and uneven stress. The internal
  anchoring strategy, through "pulling onto the bank wall, locking it inside the wall, and smooth
  transition", transforms the ends of the dam bag from suspended in air into continuously and
  securely anchored inside the wall, thus completely solving the problem of wrinkles and collapse.
  ][30]

  2026-07-15
  
  ### INFLATABLE RUBBER DAM MAINTENANCE PROCESS
  
  Inflatable Rubber Dam Maintenance Process Guide: From safety preparation to trial operation and
  acceptance, this guide covers dam bag wear repair, anchoring maintenance, and filling/draining
  system maintenance to ensure project compliance and safety. Key points: Minor wear requires
  meticulous repair; severe damage requires double-sided patching; major repairs require complete
  replacement of the entire dam. Each step involves strict temperature and pressure control,
  culminating in graded pressure tests and a 24-hour pressure holding test.
  ][29]
* [
  2026-07-13
  
  ### HOW TO SOLVE THE PROBLEM OF SHOULDER COLLAPSE IN INFLATABLE RUBBER DAMS?
  
  The shoulder collapse stems from insufficient dam end restraint and uneven stress. The internal
  anchoring strategy, through "pulling onto the bank wall, locking it inside the wall, and smooth
  transition", transforms the ends of the dam bag from suspended in air into continuously and
  securely anchored inside the wall, thus completely solving the problem of wrinkles and collapse.
  ][30]

# Inflatable Rubber Dams for Controlling Flood

Zaoqiang Dacheng Rubber Co., Ltd. is a professional manufacturer and seller of various inflatable
rubber dam. We have broad export market which is Australasia, America, Europe, Africa, etc. We offer
several kinds of inflatable rubber dam: [air inflatable rubber dam][14], [water inflatable rubber
dam][15], bookend rubber dam, shield type rubber dam and spoiler rubber dam. We also offer
[automatic control system][16] and [accessories][17]. Rubber dam is made of high strength canvas
which is as the reinforced framework and synthetic rubber. It is fixed on reinforced concrete
foundation using clamp plates and anchor bolts. It has good elasticity and tensile strength, also
can be resistant to corrosion, abrasion, rust and aging. It is widely used to retain water, control
flood, irrigation, power generation, raise existing dam, etc.

Inflatable Rubber Dam
Smooth inflatable rubber dam

Smooth inflatable rubber dam includes air inflatable rubber dam and water inflatable rubber dam.
Compared with conventional sluice dam, rubber can be suitable to any span watercourse, also can save
30-70% raw materials. It is resistant to shock, rust, foundation deformation, also has good sealing
effect, perfect seismic performance, completely collapse capability and no water resistance.

[Air or water inflatable rubber dams are installed in river with the color of blue, black and red.]
[Bookend rubber dam][18]

Bookend rubber dam has obvious fins on the dam body to form a rising angle when the dam is inflated.
The fins can heighten overflow's water head and eliminate vacuum underneath the dam to reduce the
vibration and abrasion. It is usually used to retain water, agricultural irrigation, generate
electricity, control flood, beautify environment, etc.

[There are blue, green and black bookend rubber dams on the concrete foundation.]
[Shield type rubber dam][19]

Shield type rubber dam mainly includes steel shield plate and air bladder. Steel shield plates
provide front stop water; rubber air bladders provide support for shield plate. Steel shield plates
also can protect the rubber dam from sharp substances. Steel shield plates could be stainless steel
or carbon steel. Steel shield and rubber dam are fixed on concrete foundation by clamping plates and
anchor bolts.

[Two shield type rubber dams in low water level river and a shield type rubber dam has overflow.]
[Spoiler rubber dam][20]

Spoiler rubber dam adds the spoiler seismic structure at the base of common rubber dam. It can
effectively prevent rubber dam oscillating or squirming, thereby reduce the friction with downstream
rubber protective layer result from rubber dam vibration.

[Black and blue spoiler rubber dam in the situation of with overflow and without overflow.]

The steel plate of shield type rubber dam can protect the rubber air bladder, and it has modular

# Inflatable Rubber Dams for Controlling Flood

Zaoqiang Dacheng Rubber Co., Ltd. is a professional manufacturer and seller of various inflatable
rubber dam. We have broad export market which is Australasia, America, Europe, Africa, etc. We offer
several kinds of inflatable rubber dam: [air inflatable rubber dam][14], [water inflatable rubber
dam][15], bookend rubber dam, shield type rubber dam and spoiler rubber dam. We also offer
[automatic control system][16] and [accessories][17]. Rubber dam is made of high strength canvas
which is as the reinforced framework and synthetic rubber. It is fixed on reinforced concrete
foundation using clamp plates and anchor bolts. It has good elasticity and tensile strength, also
can be resistant to corrosion, abrasion, rust and aging. It is widely used to retain water, control
flood, irrigation, power generation, raise existing dam, etc.

Inflatable Rubber Dam
Smooth inflatable rubber dam

Smooth inflatable rubber dam includes air inflatable rubber dam and water inflatable rubber dam.
Compared with conventional sluice dam, rubber can be suitable to any span watercourse, also can save
30-70% raw materials. It is resistant to shock, rust, foundation deformation, also has good sealing
effect, perfect seismic performance, completely collapse capability and no water resistance.

[Air or water inflatable rubber dams are installed in river with the color of blue, black and red.]
[Bookend rubber dam][18]

Bookend rubber dam has obvious fins on the dam body to form a rising angle when the dam is inflated.
The fins can heighten overflow's water head and eliminate vacuum underneath the dam to reduce the
vibration and abrasion. It is usually used to retain water, agricultural irrigation, generate
electricity, control flood, beautify environment, etc.

[There are blue, green and black bookend rubber dams on the concrete foundation.]
[Shield type rubber dam][19]

Shield type rubber dam mainly includes steel shield plate and air bladder. Steel shield plates
provide front stop water; rubber air bladders provide support for shield plate. Steel shield plates
also can protect the rubber dam from sharp substances. Steel shield plates could be stainless steel
or carbon steel. Steel shield and rubber dam are fixed on concrete foundation by clamping plates and
anchor bolts.

[Two shield type rubber dams in low water level river and a shield type rubber dam has overflow.]
[Spoiler rubber dam][20]

Spoiler rubber dam adds the spoiler seismic structure at the base of common rubber dam. It can
effectively prevent rubber dam oscillating or squirming, thereby reduce the friction with downstream
rubber protective layer result from rubber dam vibration.

[Black and blue spoiler rubber dam in the situation of with overflow and without overflow.]

## Who We Are

Kubota uses a wide range of products and technologies to provide solutions in the areas of food,
water, and the environment, which are indispensable for people's lives. From a grain of rice or a
drop of water to the foundations of society and industry, Kubota's solutions support the lives of
human beings.
* ### [Agriculture][170]
  
  As a comprehensive solutions provider for agriculture, Kubota offers total support at every stage
  of farming, from developing agricultural machinery that meets farmers' needs to the production,
  processing and consumption of agricultural products. Kubota supports farming throughout the world
  and contributes to a more prosperous future for people and food.
  
  [
  ][171]
* ### [Water][172]
  
  Kubota's water environment solutions are active in all aspects of the water cycle, supporting
  water infrastructure in Japan and throughout the world. As a water treatment specialist, we are
  committed to finding solutions to the world's water problems and supplying safe water to all
  people in the world.
  
  [
  ][173]
* ### [Environment][174]
  
  Social infrastructure is indispensable for our prosperous and comfortable lives. Industrial
  infrastructure serves as the foundation for manufacturing. Kubota answers the needs of society to
  offer solutions that support these infrastructures, contributing to more affluent lives for
  humans.
  
  [
  ][175]

[Groundwork for Tomorrow][176]

## Innovation

Kubota envisions the social issues that could arise in the near future and creates new services and
business and develops products in anticipation if these issues, contributing even further to
society.

[Learn More][177]

## Sustainability

Kubota considers food, water and the environment as a singular theme, and aims to realize a
sustainable society through a proper cycle of these elements using technology and solutions.

[Learn More][178]

## Who We Are

Kubota uses a wide range of products and technologies to provide solutions in the areas of food,
water, and the environment, which are indispensable for people's lives. From a grain of rice or a
drop of water to the foundations of society and industry, Kubota's solutions support the lives of
human beings.
* ### [Agriculture][170]
  
  As a comprehensive solutions provider for agriculture, Kubota offers total support at every stage
  of farming, from developing agricultural machinery that meets farmers' needs to the production,
  processing and consumption of agricultural products. Kubota supports farming throughout the world
  and contributes to a more prosperous future for people and food.
  
  [
  ][171]
* ### [Water][172]
  
  Kubota's water environment solutions are active in all aspects of the water cycle, supporting
  water infrastructure in Japan and throughout the world. As a water treatment specialist, we are
  committed to finding solutions to the world's water problems and supplying safe water to all
  people in the world.
  
  [
  ][173]
* ### [Environment][174]
  
  Social infrastructure is indispensable for our prosperous and comfortable lives. Industrial
  infrastructure serves as the foundation for manufacturing. Kubota answers the needs of society to
  offer solutions that support these infrastructures, contributing to more affluent lives for
  humans.
  
  [
  ][175]

[Groundwork for Tomorrow][176]

## Innovation

Kubota envisions the social issues that could arise in the near future and creates new services and
business and develops products in anticipation if these issues, contributing even further to
society.

[Learn More][177]

## Sustainability

Kubota considers food, water and the environment as a singular theme, and aims to realize a
sustainable society through a proper cycle of these elements using technology and solutions.

[Learn More][178]

# mind map maker

[Continue with Google][2]

mind mappers and visual thinkers

## MindMeister is the refreshingly simple mind mapping software, helping people think better since
## 2007.

[image]

Visualize

ideas instantly

[mindmeister graphic visualise mind maps]

Organize

complex information

Generate

mind maps with AI

in real time

Mind mappingBrainstormingStudy and researchTeam meetings

## Make mind maps in seconds
* Turn complex topics into clear visual structures
* Drag and drop to organize as you go
* Add links, notes, emojis and images

[Mind mapping][4]
[image]

## Capture and organize ideas
* Brainstorm live with your team
* Add comments to spark discussions
* Works on mobile, tablet and desktop

[Brainstorming][5]
[image]

## Learn with less effort
* Master tough topics faster
* Improve memory and recall
* Attach your notes directly to the map

[Study and research][6]
[image]

## Make meetings make sense
* Create a visual agenda that everyone can follow
* Use presentation mode (and skip the slide prep)
* Capture decisions and create tasks right on the map

[Team meetings][7]

MindMeister is a great way to clarify your thoughts. You can effectively structure and categorize a
huge amount of information. When you do it on paper, you can’t drag and drop, you can’t move things
around.

[image]CJM
Chelsi Jo MooreCEO, productivity coach and podcaster
[vector image]

"We develop topics collaboratively in MindMeister. This is how we build solutions from ideas."

[image]SK
Sebastian KraftHead of Bank Administration, VR-Bank Würzburg
[vector image]
Previous slideNext slide

## Make sense of anything with online mind maps

A mind map puts everything in one view, so even complex ideas become much easier to think through.
* Expand and collapse branches 
* Multiple maps in one canvas
* Outline mode for linear thinkers

[image]
[image]

## **Style your mind map your way**

Switch the layout, swap the theme, set your colours. Whatever helps you focus.
* One-click themes and colour schemes
* Mind maps, org charts and list layouts
* Custom colors saved for reuse

## **Work together on mind maps in real time**

Share your online mind maps securely with your team. Or switch to presentation mode and walk people
through your ideas without leaving the map.
* Invite collaborators with a link
* Present directly from your map
* Export to PDF, Word or PowerPoint

[image]
[image]

## Create your first mind map in minutes

Generate with AI from a prompt or file upload, or choose a template. You’ll have your first mind map
made in no time.

[security icon]

## Enterprise-grade security

As your trusted digitalization partner, we're committed to providing a secure and reliable platform
so you can manage your daily work with confidence.
* ISO 27001 certified
* Fully GDPR compliant
* Hosted in Germany
* Admin controls
* Security best practices

[Learn more][8]

## **Mind mapping software for everyone**

### Educators
* Create visual lesson plans
* Organize topics and learning material
* Run group brainstorming activities

[MindMeister for education][9]

### Students
* Understand complex topics faster
* Improve your exam prep
* Collaborate on group projects

[MindMeister for students][10]

# Welcome

Obermeyer Hydro is a leading worldwide provider of hydropower and water-control equipment as well as
inflatable rubber structures for industrial applications. Our products include
pneumatically-operated spillway gates, rubber dams, drive-over water control gates, adjustable
whitewater features, water turbine equipment, and inflatable seals for tunnel-boring applications.
Please explore our website to see how Obermeyer Hydro can help your project succeed.

# What types of rubber dams can we supply?

**Inflatable rubber dams** are manufactured from high-strength synthetic fabrics (especially nylon
canvas) and multi-layers of rubber with good and excellent resistance against weather, abrasion and
ozone. Since the first inflatable rubber dam was installed in Los Angeles County in US in the 1950s,
the rubber dam swept across the market quickly as a novel water control structure with high cost
effectiveness.

**Types of rubber dams**

Our company specializes in manufacturing and exporting quality inflatable rubber dams for over ten
years. Our main products include [air filled rubber dam][7], water filled rubber dam, bookend rubber
dam and shield type rubber dam in a wide range of sizes for different applications such as
hydropower, flood control, irrigation and water retaining.

[Read More][8]
[A blue air filled inflatable rubber dam]

**Air filled rubber dam** a cylindrical rubber weir filled with air, can be inflated and deflated
easily and quickly just using air blowers. Meanwhile, it needs narrower concrete foundation for
installation and lower cost for daily operation.

[A black water filled inflatable rubber dam]

**Water filled rubber dam** is slow to fill, yet features minimal vibration taking advantages of
high weight of water. In addition, it provides a higher overtopping about 50% of the dam height and
better to be suited to applications where there is a tail water elevation and board watercourse.

[A blue bookend inflatable rubber dam]

**Bookend rubber dam** features added spines to heighten the water head, minimize vibrations and
eliminate vacuum underneath of the dam. In addition, bookend structures make the dam excellent in
abrasion and impact resistance.

[A shield type rubber dam with black rubber bladders]

**Shield type rubber dam**, composed of air filled rubber bladders and steel shield plates, is
characterized by modular design for easy installation, adjustment and repair. It's suitable for
channels and spillways in any span regardless of sediment, bedload and floating debris.

Except above inflatable rubber dams, our company also supplies [automatic control system][9],
clamping plates and anchor bolts for easy operation and installation.

## Why choose us?

As a specialist for manufacturing inflatable rubber dams, we can provide quality products, custom
designs as well as superb services to every customer. Most of all, our products are low cost, easy
to install, operate and maintain with a long service life. Here are the unmatchable features and
benefits of our products.
* **Reliable inflation and deflation states**
  The inflatable rubber dam can be filled with air or water to designed height and pressure to store
  water during dry season. In rain seasons, air or water can be pumped out of the rubber dam quickly
  and easily to prevent flooding during high flow.
* **High resistance to sedimentation**
  Water may not flow by the excess dirt, boulder stones and sedimentations. But these will not
  trouble the inflatable rubber dam because all these sedimentations can be washed away when
  flexible rubber dam is deflated.
* **Easy and quick to install**
  No matter what size of the dam, the inflatable rubber dam delivered to the site is only one piece
  and ready to install. Therefore, only a short construction period is need to install inflatable
  rubber dam. In addition, single spans in width of over 100m may not need intermediary concrete
  piers which enhance flow characteristic and cost lower for associated civil works.
* **Easy to operate**
  Adopting advanced self adjustment system, the inflatable dam can be inflated and deflated
  automatically to control the height and pressure of the rubber dam according to water levels of
  upstream.
* **Lower construction & maintenance cost**
  Installing inflatable rubber dam is a economic choice for water flow control as it saves 30% to
  70% cements, steels and woods comparing with conventional concrete dams. Additionally, the rubber
  dam is ease of maintenance using minimal cost as there is few moving part.
* **Longer lifespan**
  The characteristics of excellent resistance to shock and abrasion make the dam capable to last
  longer about 15 to 30 years.
* **Suitable for any span**
  Inflatable rubber dams are suitable for various types of sites especially where the width is
  larger than height. Whether it be long or short span, the dams can be installed without piers,
  while the concrete dams need piers every 15 to 30 meters.

## Company Overview

Hebei Hengyang Engineering Rubber Co., Ltd. (formerly Huayang Rubber Factory) was founded in 1991
and is located in Binhu New District, Hengshui City. The Beijing-Kowloon, Shide Railway, Daguan,
Shihuang and Hengde Railway meet here. The factory is adjacent to the south side of 106 National
Highway, and the transportation is very convenient. The factory covers an area of 68,000 square
meters and the building area is 35,000 square meters. In the past 20 years since its establishment,
it has become a major domestic rubber dam manufacturer, and also a large-scale manufacturer with a
high level of technical excellence. The company currently has 338 employees, including 23 senior
technicians, 60 intermediate technicians, more than 95 million yuan in fixed assets, and a
registered capital of 100.3 million yuan. Our company has passed the IS09001 quality management
system certification. The company has a complete modern management system and implements the general
manager responsibility system under the leadership of the board of directors. The company has
office, sales department, finance department, production department, after-sales service department,
technology department, quality inspection department, supply department, warehouse and other
management departments.In order to improve product quality, the company's main person in charge
added a special production line for rubber dam bags based on the inspection of international rubber
dam manufacturing technology. This production line has been technically appraised by relevant
experts on site and has reached the international level of rubber dam manufacturing technology. It
can directly produce 3.5-meter-high seamless inflatable rubber dams. It is the largest seamless
inflatable rubber dam manufacturer in China. The company has several design engineers, product
quality and technical control engineers, and technical installation guidance engineers, and has
formed a relatively complete operation system. Enterprise spirit: high efficiency, pioneering and
enterprising, based on the country, looking at the world, grasping the future. Core values: mutual
benefit, integrity, truth-seeking and innovation, quality first. Corporate mission: to promote the
sustainable development of the industry. The company's main products include: water-filled rubber
dams, anchors, automation control system equipment, bridge bearings, water stop belts, bridge
inflatable cores, ultra-wide special rubber conveyor belts, rubber filter belts, ultra-wide ring
belts, mining supplies, casting products and other types of rubber products. All employees of the
company sincerely welcome new and old customers to visit, guide and negotiate!

and is located in Binhu New District, Hengshui City. The Beijing-Kowloon, Shide Railway, Daguan,

Highway, and the transportation is very convenient. The factory covers an area of 68,000 square

technicians, 60 intermediate technicians, more than 95 million yuan in fixed assets, and a
registered capital of 100.3 million yuan. Our company has passed the IS09001 quality management

office, sales department, finance department, production department, after-sales service department,
technology department, quality inspection department, supply department, warehouse and other
management departments.In order to improve product quality, the company's main person in charge

experts on site and has reached the international level of rubber dam manufacturing technology. It
can directly produce 3.5-meter-high seamless inflatable rubber dams. It is the largest seamless
inflatable rubber dam manufacturer in China. The company has several design engineers, product
quality and technical control engineers, and technical installation guidance engineers, and has

enterprising, based on the country, looking at the world, grasping the future. Core values: mutual
benefit, integrity, truth-seeking and innovation, quality first. Corporate mission: to promote the
sustainable development of the industry. The company's main products include: water-filled rubber
dams, anchors, automation control system equipment, bridge bearings, water stop belts, bridge
inflatable cores, ultra-wide special rubber conveyor belts, rubber filter belts, ultra-wide ring
belts, mining supplies, casting products and other types of rubber products. All employees of the

## Every single person at Thetford makes the difference

While we come from different backgrounds and cultures, we all have and share the same values in the
way we work with each other.

We do not just make products, we create them. Every step we make together with our colleagues. We
imagine, create, develop, produce, transport and support.

We work together with thinkers and with doers, so we can act global, think local and do what we
love.

[toss ins 16ct aqua kem resized]

### Blue is back!

One of our most popular RV holding tank treatments, Aqua-Kem Toss-Ins®, has returned. Perfect for
RVs and marine applications, the Bronopol-based formula liquefies waste, breaks down tissue, and
delivers superior odor control.

[ Aqua-Kem Toss-Ins® ][67]
[Thetford Aqua Magic VI Homepage Banner]

### Constantly improving RV sanitation

Introducing the Aqua-Magic® VI, a lightweight RV toilet designed to bring the comfort of a home
toilet to your travels, along with easy cleaning and low maintenance.

[ Aqua-Magic® VI ][68]
[Titan Tote 4 wheel Airstream Homepage Banner]

### Changing the standards

At Thetford®, we never stop looking for ways to improve and break patterns. Titan® portable totes
have the industry’s lowest fill height. This makes allows easy emptying for even the lowest RV waste
valves.

[ Portable totes ][69]

## Every single person at Thetford makes the difference

While we come from different backgrounds and cultures, we all have and share the same values in the
way we work with each other.

We do not just make products, we create them. Every step we make together with our colleagues. We
imagine, create, develop, produce, transport and support.

We work together with thinkers and with doers, so we can act global, think local and do what we
love.

### Blue is back!

One of our most popular RV holding tank treatments, Aqua-Kem Toss-Ins®, has returned. Perfect for
RVs and marine applications, the Bronopol-based formula liquefies waste, breaks down tissue, and
delivers superior odor control.

### Constantly improving RV sanitation

Introducing the Aqua-Magic® VI, a lightweight RV toilet designed to bring the comfort of a home
toilet to your travels, along with easy cleaning and low maintenance.

### Changing the standards

At Thetford®, we never stop looking for ways to improve and break patterns. Titan® portable totes
have the industry’s lowest fill height. This makes allows easy emptying for even the lowest RV waste
valves.

## Root Canal Treatment

Root Canal Treatment (RCT) is a procedure used to treat infected or damaged tooth pulp, relieving
pain and saving the tooth. Essential products used in RCT include a Rubber Dam for isolation, an
Endomotor and Files for canal preparation, and an Apex Locator for precise working length
determination. GP (Gutta-Percha) and Paper Points help in canal filling and drying, while X-ray RVG
ensures accuracy. Finally, Filling Material restores the tooth’s structure, ensuring
long-term success.

# Shaping the decarbonisation of marine and energy


Our everyday lives depend on a steady supply of electricity and goods shipped to us from across the
world.

Yet, marine and energy generate over a third of global greenhouse gases. That’s why we’re shaping
the decarbonisation of marine and energy.

[About us][8]

2050

net-zero target year
for shipping and energy

180

countries with our
energy installations

110,000

vessels sailing worldwide,
one-third using our solutions

3,500

Wärtsilä service professionals
in the field

## Enabling you to cut emissions at sea and on land

We help our customers take a decarbonisation journey that is environmentally sustainable and
financially viable.

[Senayan power plant in Indonesia]
[lightning-icon]
Energy

We help the energy sector accelerate the transition towards a 100% renewable energy future with our
market-leading technologies and power system expertise. Energy providers globally rely on our
flexible engine power plants, energy storage systems, intelligent optimisation technologies, and
lifecycle services. With reliable, affordable, and sustainable power as your goal, our solutions
support you in ramping up and balancing intermittent renewables.

[Wärtsilä in energy][9]
[Gas tanker on open sea]
[marine-icon]
Marine

With Wärtsilä as your partner, your maritime operations can be smarter, cleaner, and more efficient.
One in three of the world’s large vessels already relies on our technologies – power, propulsion and
other solutions – because you value reliability, safety, and performance. And as the industry moves
toward alternative fuels and digital ecosystems, we help you stay ahead with our future-proof
solutions.

[Wärtsilä in marine][10]
[Power plant in the desert]
[Service men at pier]
[Freight vessel in port]

## Interim report for April-June 2026 has been published

In the second quarter of 2026, Wärtsilä’s total order intake increased by 33% to 2,849 MEUR to an
all-time high quarter, contributing to an all-time high order book of 8,976 MEUR. The operating
result increased by 14% to EUR 209 million, representing 13.4% of net sales. Cash flow from
operating activities increased to EUR 497 million.

[Read more][11]

## Global impact. Succeeding together.

From world-first technology launches to performance-based agreements, we innovate to create value
with our customers and partners.

[
Solvang

Onboard carbon capture successfully cuts CO2 emissions by 70% for Solvang’s Clipper Eris carrier

][12][
Aqualectra, Curacao

Installed a new 38.4 MW grid balancing engine power plant in addition to the 25 MW / 45 MWh Energy
Storage System installed earlier.

][13][
GIGA Storage BV

Installed Wärtsilä's 25 MW / 48 MWh energy storage in the Netherlands, improving grid stability and
scaling renewable integration.

][14][
Viking Line

Finnish ferry company Viking Line is a market leader in passenger transport in the northern Baltic
Sea region.

][15][
United Power

United Power manages over 2,137 MW of installed capacity in Bangladesh, of which 1,066 MW is powered
by Wärtsilä engines.

][16][
Clearway Energy

Partnered with Wärtsilä for storage solutions supporting reliable renewable energy in California and
Hawaii.

][17]
[leaf-icon]
Green is not black or white.

While no single solution will carry us through the transition, we already have most of the
technology needed to decarbonise. From engines that run flexibly on low- and zero-carbon fuels to
AI-driven predictive analytics, we are using all tools in the toolbox to help our customers take the
next step on their decarbonisation journey.

[Our story][18]

result increased by 14% to EUR 209 million, representing 13.4% of net sales. Cash flow from
operating activities increased to EUR 497 million.
